page.layout: One title page. Centred title block in capitals, with the author's name at the top and a printer's ornament between the lines. Below it a woodcut engraving (a serpent winding up through a hand, with two scrolls reading VENENVM and NEQVE). Under the engraving the imprint: GENEVÆ, Typis Matthæi Berjon., M. D C. XXX.

l.i: Qui supplem. vice D. Chamieri Panstratiæ in editione Germanica adiectus est.

main_text.l: Accessit JOH. PRIDEAUXII Oxon. Acad. Theol. de Ecclesiæ Visibilitate,
doctissima lectio: & BEN. TUR. Prof. Gen. de Natura

page.notes: The woodcut ornament between the author's name and the title, and the engraving of the serpent and hand with the scrolls VENENVM and NEQVE, are not text and are not transcribed. The top line "IOH. HENR. ALSTEDII" and the imprint date are as printed. Italic setting is judged from the scan and is uncertain for "Typis Matthæi Berjon." and "BECANI,". The long s in "Panstratiæ" and "est" has been normalised to s. No page number or running head is printed.
